sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have carefully reviewed your counter-offer and welcome the proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable stability for both sides. For our primary Angebot, we can present a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

However, as a family-run business, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for us, but we are prepared to compromise at 45 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit, with a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

As a long-standing partner, we expect negotiations to progress constructively rather than regressively. Our foundry has stood for quality and reliable cooperation over many years, and we value the deep ties between our companies. We maintain our offer of €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust in our shared history and look forward to reaching a positive conclusion together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. As a family-run foundry, we value our long-standing relationship, but we cannot accept regressive offers that undermine our mutual trust.

We have already accommodated your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms at €52.20, which represents a fair and sustainable agreement. To be precise, our current offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We maintain our position and expect a return to a constructive dialogue to reach a positive conclusion.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
